metaDescriptionZh: 本拿比牙科诊所如何在7天内完成全面商业翻新。了解Reno Stars如何将4-6周的工程压缩到一周——范围、时间表和费用明细。
contentEn:
When a Burnaby dental clinic needed a full commercial renovation completed in one week, Reno Stars made it happen. A project that typically takes four to six weeks was delivered in seven days — without compromising on quality, safety, or the details that matter in a medical space.

Reno Stars took on the complete job: reception area, three exam rooms, a staff kitchenette, and an admin workspace. The clinic had already been Reno Stars clients — they knew the standard to expect, and they needed the speed.

The secret was pre-fabrication and parallel trades. Cabinets and countertops were measured and ordered before demo was complete. Electricians, plumbers, and finishers worked simultaneously in different zones rather than sequentially. One crew stayed on-site for the full week.

How do you finish a dental clinic renovation in one week?

The compressed timeline required upfront planning that would seem excessive for a normal schedule. Every material was confirmed for lead time before the start date. A detailed phase map showed which trade worked in which zone at which hour. The City of Burnaby building team was contacted early — expedited permits for commercial renovations in occupied medical spaces require pre-clearance.

The result: Reno Stars handed back a fully operational clinic on day seven, with zero outstanding punch-list items.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

What does a commercial dental clinic renovation cost in Metro Vancouver?

Costs vary significantly by scope and finish level. A full gut renovation of a small dental clinic in Burnaby typically ranges from $75,000 to $150,000 for a single-level space of 1,000–2,500 square feet. The牙科诊所 in this project fell in the $75,000–$150,000 range for the completed four-zone fit-out.

Medical spaces require additional code compliance costs: proper HVAC separation, medical-grade flooring transitions, and exam room lighting levels that meet WorkSafeBC standards. These are not optional and should appear in every contractor's scope.

What was the actual scope for this project?

Reno Stars managed four distinct zones within the same week:

  • Reception: new flooring, reception desk, waiting area lighting
  • Kitchenette: full-cabinet replacement, quartz countertop, new fixtures
  • Three exam rooms: flooring, trim, LED upgrade
  • Admin workspace: open plan reconfiguration, data and power rough-in

Each zone had a dedicated lead craftsman. They communicated via daily morning walkthrough and a shared messaging thread. No zone waited on another.

Is a one-week dental clinic renovation realistic?

It is — for a contractor with established trade relationships, a client with clear decision-making authority, and a space that does not require structural changes. Where it breaks down is when clients need time to select finishes or when building management imposes restrictions on work hours.

The牙科诊所 project succeeded because the client had approved the material selections in advance, the space was unoccupied during work, and the building allowed full-noise work from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on weekdays.

What would change for a bigger clinic?

A larger clinic — say, 5,000+ square feet or a two-story fit-out — cannot realistically be completed in one week. The realistic timeline for a large medical tenant improvement is six to ten weeks. The pre-fabrication and parallel-trades model still applies, but the sequencing stretches proportionally.

Budget for $90–$180 per square foot for a complete medical office renovation in Metro Vancouver in 2026, depending on finish level and whether the scope includes medical equipment rough-ins.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

How long does a dental clinic renovation take in Burnaby?

A small to mid-size dental clinic renovation in Burnaby takes one to six weeks depending on scope. A full gut renovation with four or more zones can be completed in one week with a dedicated crew and pre-approved materials. Larger spaces require six to ten weeks minimum.

Do dental clinics need special permits for renovation in Metro Vancouver?

Yes. Commercial dental clinics in Burnaby require a building permit for any work that changes the floor plan, electrical, or plumbing systems. Medical spaces have additional requirements under WorkSafeBC and Vancouver Coastal Health for occupied renovation. A qualified contractor handles the permit application as part of the project scope.

What is the cost per square foot for a dental clinic renovation in Metro Vancouver?

A full dental clinic renovation in Metro Vancouver costs $90–$180 per square foot in 2026, depending on finish level, scope, and whether the work includes medical equipment rough-ins. A 1,500-square-foot clinic would fall in the $135,000–$270,000 range for a complete fit-out.

Can Reno Stars handle both commercial and residential renovations?

Yes. Reno Stars works across kitchen, bathroom, whole-home, and commercial projects. The dental clinic project was a commercial fit-out; the same project management structure applies to retail, office, and warehouse renovations.
contentZh:
本拿比一家牙科诊所需要在七天内完成全面商业翻新。Reno Stars 让这一切成为现实。通常需要四到六周的项目在七天内交付——同时不妥协于质量、安全或医疗空间的细节要求。

Reno Stars 承担了整个工程：接待区、三间诊疗室、员工休息室和行政工作区。该诊所此前已是 Reno Stars 的客户——他们了解服务标准，也迫切需要速度。

成功的关键是预制和并行施工。橱柜和台面在拆除完成前就已测量下单。水电工、木工和装修工同时在不同区域施工，而非顺序进行。整个工程期间，一支团队驻场。

如何在短短一周内完成牙科诊所翻新？

压缩工期需要在开工前进行表面看起来过多的前期规划。所有材料在开工日期前确认交货时间。详细的阶段图显示每个工种在哪个区域、哪个时段作业。本拿比市建筑团队提前沟通——繁忙医疗空间的加急许可需要预先批准。

结果：Reno Stars 在第七天交付了完全可运营的诊所，零遗留清单项目。

大温哥华地区商业牙科诊所翻新的费用是多少？

费用因范围和装修等级差异很大。本拿比一间小型牙科诊所的全面翻新工程，对于 1,000–2,500 平方英尺的单层空间，通常在 $75,000 至 $150,000 之间。本项目中四个区域的工程属于此范围。

医疗空间需要额外的合规成本：HVAC 系统隔离、医疗级地板过渡，以及符合 WorkSafeBC 标准的诊疗室照明水平。这些都是必需的，应体现在每个承包商的范围说明中。

本项目的实际范围是什么？

Reno Stars 在同一周内管理四个不同区域：

  • 接待区：新地板、接待台、等候区照明
  • 休息室：全套橱柜更换、石英石台面、新固定装置
  • 三间诊疗室：地板、装饰线条、LED 升级
  • 行政工作区：开放式布局重新配置、数据和电源预埋

每个区域有专职工匠负责。他们通过每日现场巡查和共享消息线程沟通。区域之间无需等待。

一周完成牙科诊所翻新现实吗？

对于拥有稳定合作关系、客户决策权明确且空间不需要结构变更的承包商来说，这是现实的。问题在于客户需要时间选择饰面，或建筑管理对工作时间施加限制时。

本项目成功的关键在于：客户提前批准了材料选择，施工期间空间空置，建筑允许工作日 8 a.m. 至 6 p.m. 的全噪音施工。

更大的诊所会有什么不同？

更大的诊所（例如 5,000+ 平方英尺或两层装修）无法在一周内完成。大型医疗装修的现实工期为六至十周。预制和并行施工模式仍然适用，但工序会相应延长。

2026 年大温哥华地区医疗办公室翻新的预算为每平方英尺 $90–$180，取决于装修等级、范围以及是否包含医疗设备预埋。

本拿比牙科诊所翻新需要多长时间？

本拿比中小型牙科诊所翻新根据范围不同需要一至六周。四个或以上区域的全面翻新，在专职团队和预批材料的前提下可在一周内完成。更大的空间至少需要六至十周。

大温哥华牙科诊所翻新需要特殊许可吗？

是的。本拿比商业牙科诊所对于任何改变平面图、电气或管道系统的工程都需要建筑许可。医疗空间在 Occupied 翻新方面有 WorkSafeBC 和 Vancouver Coastal Health 的额外要求。合格的承包商将作为项目范围的一部分处理许可申请。

大温哥华地区牙科诊所翻新每平方英尺的成本是多少？

2026 年大温哥华地区全面牙科诊所翻新每平方英尺成本为 $90–$180，取决于装修等级、范围以及是否包含医疗设备预埋。1,500 平方英尺的诊所，全面装修的价格范围在 $135,000 至 $270,000 之间。

Reno Stars 能承接商业和住宅翻新吗？

是的。Reno Stars 承接厨房、浴室、全屋及商业项目。牙科诊所项目属于商业装修；同样的项目管理结构适用于零售、办公室和仓库翻新。
